caveats:
There may be a delay of a few days between when new country boundaries are added to HDX and when they are aggregated into this global dataset.  
  
In the edge-matched resource, lower levels are filled in with higher ones if they don't exist. Example: Admin 2 is used to fill in Admin 3 and 4 if they don't exist. Also, only layers with full coverage are used for this resource. Example: if Admin 3 only covers part of a location, Admin 2 is used instead.
dataset_source: Multiple sources aggregated by UN OCHA Information Systems Section (ISS)
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
methodology_other: Data taken from administrative boundary layers available on HDX. Edge-extending of original geometries is automatically applied using an [algorithm](https://github.com/fieldmaps/edge-extender). Extended boundaries are then clipped against international boundaries to achieve edge-matching.
name: cod-ab-global
notes:
Administrative level 1-4 boundaries for 115 countries / territories, using the latest version for each.  
  
This dataset combines the [country COD-AB datasets](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/?cod_level=cod-ab) and contains:  
  
- **Edge-Matched**: Subnational boundaries are aligned to fit international boundaries. This process results in simplification at the international border, but gaps and overlaps are eliminated. The internal resolution of each subnational boundary layer is not modified by this process. Recommended to use for most use cases.
- **Original**: Subnational boundaries are unmodified from their original source. There will be gaps and overlaps at the international border. Recommended if maintaining the integrity of the initial source is important.
- **Metadata**: A table of the sources used.  
  
**Related datasets**  
  
- [Country COD-AB datasets](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/?cod_level=cod-ab): for boundaries of a single country or territory.
- [Global P-code List](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/global-pcodes): P-codes and names as CSV, for data collection tools such as ODK / Kobo.
- [Global - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (Historic)](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global-historic): past versions of boundaries for each country or territory.
